# wallix-bastion_config_x509_crl (Data Source)

Get information on the CRL revocation check of the certificates used for X509 authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wallix-bastion_config_x509_crl" "current" {}

output "crl_check" {
  value = data.wallix-bastion_config_x509_crl.current.crl_check
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `crl_auto_fetch` (String)
- `crl_check` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Usage Notes

`config_x509_crl` is a singleton, so this data source takes no arguments. It reads the
configuration managed by the `wallix-bastion_config_x509_crl` resource.

The CRL file uploaded with `crl_file` isn't exposed: the API never returns it.
